ui.memory.error.notFound: The note is no longer there.
ui.memory.error.revision: The note changed since you opened it. Read it again before you change it.
ui.memory.error.unsafe: The note does not pass the checks yet. Edit it first.

ui.memory.lead: What the agents kept for the conversations they were called in: decisions, findings and notes, one folder for each agent in each conversation. Open a note to read who wrote it and when, edit it, mark it reviewed or remove it. The next agent that reads the memory sees your change, and an agent cannot replace a note you edited.
ui.memory.list.label: Notes of {agent}
ui.memory.loadError: The memory could not be read.
ui.memory.off: The shared memory is off for this workspace: agents neither read nor write it. You can still read, edit and remove what is here. Turn it on in Settings › Runner.
ui.memory.panel.missing: This note is no longer there.
ui.memory.refusal.control: has an invisible or direction-changing character; remove it, the text must be readable as written
